topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: ain't nothing surprises me anymore, but this one hits a little closer to home. Friend of mine, or so I thought, been spinning me a tale. Lied about his job, or lack thereof. Makes a man wonder how many more threads in that tapestry are frayed, how many more truths are just threads away from coming loose. City don't change, people do, and not always for the better. Guess it's time to peel back the layers and find out what's really going on, see if there's anything left to salvage. Rain keeps falling, and the streets, they shine with the kind of light that highlights every lie, every shadow. Time to wade in, even if the waters are murky.
